entities.summary: Zakhariy Knyazevich Kalashov, nicknamed "Young Shakro", is a Georgian born, Russian mafia boss, notorious gangster and thief in law of Yazidi origin. He is widely believed to be one of the most prominent figures in the Russian underworld.
